newsitem.title: USA: Dow lost more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow lost more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average lost more than 50 points in late afternoon trading Monday as the market was the target of profit-taking after last week's sharp run-up.

At 3:10 p.m. EDT, the Dow index was off 52.02 points at 7,843.79, which reactivated the New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading. This morning, the limits were activated when the Dow rose 50 points.
